description: Check a site's transport and headers: the plain-http → https redirect, HSTS, Content-Security-Policy (enforced or report-only, unsafe-inline), clickjacking protection, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, mixed content and security.txt — each pass / improve / fix with how to fix it. Fetches the homepage once as our crawler after robots.txt, plus one request to the http:// address; stores nothing. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: check_site_security

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Check security headers
